issues.description: The commented example in the template Main uses two-argument constructors for the animals (e.g. Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the UML/specification and the solution implementation define animal constructors that take only a single parameter (the name). The UML (Animal has only the name attribute) and the solution classes (Seal, Pig, Goat) provide one-argument constructors, so the two-argument examples in the template Main are inconsistent and may confuse students about the required constructor signature.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the constructor signatures consistent. Either (preferred) update the commented example in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to use single-argument constructors (e.g. Seal("Clarabelle"), Pig("Doodle"), Goat("Buttinsky")) to match the UML and solution, or if the intent was to have an additional attribute (e.g. type/habitat), update the UML, problem text, and solution classes to include that attribute and corresponding constructor parameter.
